scope.summary: A spot swatch MUST support an optional Lab definition used for accurate screen and soft-proof simulation independent of any CMYK alternate, plus a per-use tint percentage; the spot separates as its own plate regardless of the display alternate (AI spot-Lab values; ID spot swatches, deduped). Implement spot Lab definition, per-use tint, and own-plate separation behavior.
acceptance_criteria: spot swatch optional Lab + per-use tint; separates as own plate independent of display alternate
expected_tests: test: spot swatch optional Lab definition drives screen/soft-proof simulation independent of CMYK alternate; per-use tint %
live: spot separates as its own plate regardless of display alternate

gui_obligation.not_applicable_reason: Headless/backend MT: no operator-visible surface changed.

user_manual_obligation.not_applicable_reason: Non-product-behavior or internal-scaffold MT; UserManual updated by the consuming feature MT.

risk_if_missed: Spot color mis-proofs / merges into process; prepress fidelity unmet.

risks: Scaffold-only claim without runtime proof (Spec-Realism Gate).
Domain MT forking a canonical primitive instead of referencing 14.23.
SQLite creep on a studio_* write path.
minimum_controls: At least one proof command exercises executable runtime or a Handshake-managed resource boundary.
Reference canonical primitives (14.23); no shadow primitives.
